description: Claude's own check of the 52 items on the hand-check page (the version 5 output for 16 companies). Each link was opened and read as a person would read it, without the agent's code. This is a model's check; the hand check by a person is reported separately in the README.
version_checked: 4c1f2c111c1d7d8b1e20fab2836626287a7d83ea, with the two news fixes of 0d7090f and cc064a8
found_and_fixed: Social: 912811042 ADVOKAT HELLELAND (a sole proprietorship): instagram.com/helleland is the owner's private personal account; it came in because the handle equals the domain helleland.one. For a sole proprietorship only a handle with the whole business name now counts (commit 00884d2).

Jobs: 820227492 HOMELY AS: the careers page links to Homely's Jobylon list, filled in by a script, so the agent saw no ads although six were live. The agent now reads the list's embed script and then each ad (commit 8e2a5e4). Checked on the real ads with the code at that commit: 3 of the 6 are published (posted within 120 days, Homely as the hiring organisation, live); 3 older ads without an end date (posted April 2026 and February 2024) are left out by the freshness rule.
